text:
maria: Quick follow-up from PM — consolidating postmortem actions from last night's 503 spike. I'm listing owners, Jira tickets, RACI and suggested timelines. Please ack, add any blockers, and confirm sequencing.

sam: Ack. I'll take INF-5872 (RCA + log digest). ETA Wed 2026-03-25 EOD. I'll attach logs and timeline.

incidents-bot: JIRA created INF-5872 -> https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-5872

olivia: I'll own the circuit-breaker tuning work. Created INF-5880. Target 2026-04-01. Need kernel/queueing metrics from eng-infra to pick safe thresholds.

dan: Can we make the RACI explicit in the tickets? Suggest R=olivia, A=sam, C=eng-infra, I=pm (maria).

maria: Yes, I'll add that to each ticket. Also, the kv-cache eviction pattern looks recurring — moving it to the recurring-incidents board. Sam, can you capture pattern/examples in INF-5873?

sam: On it. Created INF-5873 (recurring-kv-eviction-pattern). ETA Fri.

ruth: I'll own runbook/playbook updates and handoff to oncall. Created INF-5881 — will write steps, runbook PR, and playbook checklist. ETA 2026-03-30.

olivia: Heads-up: want a short canary config change before global rollout. Can't do full rollback without perf baseline. I'll make a canary PR and tag @eng-sre.

dan: @olivia add me to the PR, happy to help with loadgen and validation.

maria: Timeline summary:
- INF-5872 (RCA): sam, due 2026-03-25
- INF-5873 (Pattern capture): sam, due 2026-03-27
- INF-5880 (Circuit-breaker tuning / canary): olivia, due 2026-04-01
- INF-5881 (Runbook / playbook): ruth, due 2026-03-30
Action items: every owner add label `remediation:postmortem-2026-03-22` and link back to this thread. If you hit a blocker >24h, escalate to @maria.

sam: :thumbsup: will add labels and link.

incidents-bot: Reminder set: weekly remediation check-in on the remediation board every Tue @10:00am starting 2026-03-31.

ruth: Quick Q — who will own the customer SLA credit communication?

maria: I'll own customer comms. Draft in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PM-503-spike — will post a draft by Tue and @channel when done.

dan: Also adding a small metric alert for KV cache regen events (INF-5890). I'll own the alert + dashboard. ETA 3 days.

sam: Any sequencing constraints? e.g., should runbook be published before canary?

olivia: Prefer runbook first so oncall has clear rollback and validation steps during canary. Ruth please publish runbook before I start canary.

maria: Confirmed: runbook (INF-5881) before canary (INF-5880). I'll set the canary gate in the rollout checklist.

olivia: :eyes: creating PR branch now and will tag eng-sre/qa.

dan: Added myself to INF-5890 watchers and linked dashboards.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem doc with RACI and link all tickets. Closing the immediate follow-up thread — leave replies here if anything changes or you need the escalation.
